next.reason: 1985: without IN, symbolic-character-1 is the character at ordinal integer-1 in the native character set; with IN, at that ordinal in alphabet-name-2's set. §2023:12.3.7.4 GR11 b): with ALPHANUMERIC specified or implied (always, for 1985 text), 'the value of figurative constant symbolic-character-1 is the representation of the coded character at ordinal position integer-1 in the native alphanumeric character set or, if the IN phrase is specified, in the character set referenced by alphabet-name-3'; §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR10 makes the figurative constant represent that character. NATIONAL is new syntax.
